prompt:
Create a redesigned UI mockup for TripLOG's save-status indicator and collaboration dialog, using the two supplied screenshots as redesign references. Show one coherent landscape design board with a large desktop dialog on the left and its mobile adaptation on the right. Keep the existing TripLOG identity: white surfaces, dark navy text, sunny yellow primary actions, pale sky-blue accents, Pretendard-like Korean typography. Refine the hierarchy with generous but efficient spacing, thin dividers, restrained borders, clear icons, and rounded corners.

Desktop: header "저장 및 공동 작업", subtitle "교토 여행 · 자동 저장", a small connection indicator and a top-right close icon. Use a compact left navigation with "저장 상태", "공동 메모", "댓글·담당자", "정산 확정", "변경 기록", "복구 기록", "멤버"; visibly select 저장 상태. In the main area, show a calm amber notice "확인이 필요한 변경 2건" and "양쪽 내용은 안전하게 보관되어 있어요." Below, emphasize a readable comparison titled "어떤 내용을 반영할까요?" Show a fictional "시간 변경" example with side-by-side columns "내 기기" and "공유된 내용", displaying 10:00 and 10:30, plus a compact second row "일정 삭제". Make the decision area explicit: yellow primary "내 변경 적용", secondary "공유 내용 사용", and a lower-emphasis option "내 사본 보관 후 공유 내용 사용". Move "문제 해결 및 진단" into a quiet disclosure at the bottom.

Mobile: compact app header with TripLOG, a small amber "확인 2건" status pill and menu icon; a full-height collaboration sheet with clear close control, compact horizontally scrollable navigation, stacked comparison, and reachable bottom actions. Include a small component strip showing status pills "모두 저장됨", "저장 중", "오프라인", "확인 2건". Label the board "목업 예시". Focus on the usable product UI and legible Korean labels.

Input images:
- Image 1: user-supplied part of TripLOG to redesign.
- Image 2: user-supplied part of TripLOG to redesign.
purpose: TripLOG save status and collaboration dialog redesign concept; illustrative data only
